overview: 本期共收录 12 篇论文。研究方向主要集中在金融经济学（9 篇）、绿色金融与可持续发展（1 篇）、收入分配与福利（1 篇）。方法上以均衡模型、实验方法为主。来源分布：arXiv（7 篇）、Semantic Scholar（4 篇）、OpenAlex（1 篇）。其中 1 篇命中顶级期刊白名单。

papers.title: A Sociolegal Study of Marriage Registrars’ Implementation of The Circular on Remarriage During a Former Wife’s Iddah
papers.venue: Journal of Economics Law and Humanities
papers.abstract: Background/Introduction: Administrative guidance on remarriage during a former wife’s iddah raises questions about legal interpretation and consistency in marriage registration. Research Objectives: This study examines registrars’ interpretations of the circular’s binding force, their reported handling considerations, and differences in application outcomes in Magetan Regency. Methodology: An exploratory qualitative study employed an empirical legal approach and a sociology-of-law perspective. Data comprised preliminary Google Forms responses from 18 registrars, supported by legal materials and scholarly literature. Analysis drew on Friedman’s legal system framework and Lipsky’s street-level bureaucracy perspective. Results: Eight KUA offices reported ten relevant applications during 2024–October 2026. Five reportedly resulted in postponement until iddah ended, while five proceeded before its reported completion. Registrars reported knowing the guidance and requesting postponement but expressed different interpretations of administrative authority and family circumstances. Case documents remain independently unverified, and attribution and chronological discrepancies limit interpretation. Unique Contribution: The study distinguishes reported policy knowledge, interpretive orientations, and application outcomes without assuming a direct causal relationship. Conclusion: Reported awareness of the circular did not always lead to postponement. However, the evidence does not establish the effectiveness of implementation or the legal validity of individual decisions. Recommendations: Authorities should clarify consultation procedures and strengthen decision documentation. Further research should verify case records and incorporate applicants’ and former spouses’ perspectives.
papers.summary_zh:
【金融经济学】**背景/引言**：关于前妻“iddah”（守寡期）期间再婚的行政指导，引发了关于法律解释及婚姻登记一致性的疑问。  
**研究目的**：本研究探讨了婚姻登记员对相关通知约束力的理解、他们在处理此类申请时的考量，以及马格坦县（Magetan Regency）在申请处理结果上的差异。  
**研究方法**：采用探索性定性研究方法，结合实证法律分析与法律社会学视角。数据来源包括18名婚姻登记员的初步问卷调查结果（通过Google Forms收集），并辅以法律文献和学术资料。分析过程中参考了弗里德曼（Friedman）的法律体系框架及利普斯基（Lipsky）关于基层官僚制度的理论。  
**研究结果**：2024年至2026年10月期间，共有8个婚姻登记办公室收到了10起相关申请。其中5例申请被推迟至“iddah”期结束，5例申请在“iddah”期结束前获得处理。登记员表示知晓相关指导规定并主动要求推迟处理，但对行政权力的理解及对家庭情况的判断存在差异。由于案例文件尚未经过独立核实，且相关信息的来源和时间顺序存在矛盾，因此难以对具体情况作出明确判断。  
**研究的独特贡献**：本研究...。

papers.title: Stock bubbles in limited participation models with power utilities
papers.abstract: We prove that the equilibrium state-price deflated cum-dividend stock-price process in Guasoni, Larsen, and Leoni (2025) is a strict local martingale. Our result is based on proving that the unrestricted trader faces an endogenously complete model.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】我们证明了Guasoni、Larsen和Leoni（2025）提出的均衡状态价格经通胀调整后的累积股息股票价格过程是一个严格局部鞅。我们的研究结果基于这样一个前提：不受限制的交易者面对的是一个内生完备的模型。。研究方法：均衡模型。

papers.title: Vibe-Trading: Towards Agent-Native Trading
papers.abstract: Existing AI agents can retrieve information, call tools, run experiments, and produce multi-step outputs. Yet most are built around relatively static workflows and struggle to preserve reliable state as the environment changes. Financial trading makes this limitation especially consequential: prices, news, market conditions, portfolio positions, and available capital evolve continuously. A result is useful only when it remains tied to the correct time, data snapshot, and execution context. We present Vibe-Trading, a comprehensive agent-native trading framework and all-in-one workspace for building, evaluating, and evolving agents for financial trading. It unifies market research, financial data, strategy generation, backtesting, portfolio analysis, paper trading, multi-agent collaboration, and optional broker execution. Its central contribution is an architecture that keeps results, evidence, research history, and trading authority connected throughout the research-to-action process. Each result retains its source, temporal scope, configuration, and producing run. Shared evidence grounding enables verification, versioned research records support reproducible continuation, and an explicit authority gate separates strategy research from live execution. Together, these designs provide a practical foundation for trading agents whose results can be traced, reproduced, and acted on only under explicit authority.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】现有的人工智能代理能够检索信息、调用工具、运行实验并生成多步骤的输出结果。然而，大多数这类代理都是基于相对静态的工作流程构建的，当环境发生变化时，它们难以保持状态的一致性。在金融交易领域，这一局限性尤为突出：价格、新闻、市场状况、投资组合持仓以及可用资本都在持续变化。只有当结果与正确的时间点、数据快照和执行环境相匹配时，它们才具有实际意义。我们提出了Vibe-Trading，这是一个专为金融交易设计的综合性代理框架及一体化工作环境，用于构建、评估和优化交易代理。该平台整合了市场研究、金融数据、策略生成、回测、投资组合分析、模拟交易、多代理协作以及可选的经纪商执行功能。其核心优势在于构建了一种架构，能够在整个从研究到执行的过程中保持结果、证据、研究历史和交易权限的紧密关联。每个结果都保留了其来源、时间范围、配置以及生成过程的相关信息。共享的证据机制支持验证，版本化的研究记录便于后续复现，而明确的权限控制机制则将策略研究与实际交易操作区分开来。这些设计共同为交易代理提供了实用的基础，确保其结果只有在经过明确授权的情况下才能被追踪、复现和执行。。研究方法：实验方法。

papers.title: The current macroeconomic situation in Ireland
papers.venue: Central European Review of Economics & Finance
papers.abstract: Ireland holds the Presidency of the Council of the European Union for the current six months. It is worth taking this opportunity to take a closer look at the state of its economy. The economic outlook for Ireland is optimistic. Assuming the end of the conflict in the Middle East, which is a bigger problem for the pro-export structure of Irish companies than the war in Ukraine, we can expect new FDI in sectors other than those exploited so far, e.g. AI computing centers, renewable energy (wind farms) or even the agri-food processing sector. Traditionally, Ireland will count on investors from the USA, as well as partial (e.g. in agriculture) financing from EU funds. The economic elites are counting on the success of Trump's policy of strengthening the role of the United States. The Irish government is aware of the importance of the presence of both American and other foreign companies for employment and budgetary policy, and will strive to promote Ireland as Europe's industrial hub in modern technologies of the 21st century. The rapid development of the US economy will generate demand for Irish products, especially in modern technologies (including space technologies – the development of the space conquest program by E. Musk in the next 20 years), and a possible drop in energy prices may reduce the operating costs of industry and transport in the near future. At that time, the political position of the Republic of Ireland in the perspective of 2030. will increase significantly, and the prospect of reunification with the poorer north of the island will be more realistic. After reunification, and assuming the current high immigration dynamics, with a demographic substitutability level of 1.15, there would be more than 8 million people living in a united Ireland – a return to the 1841 value of 8.2 million people.  Before we get into the main content, it is important to note a particularly positive feature of the political and economic system of Ireland, where there are no extreme political forces such as the extreme right or the extreme left. The Communist Party does not exist here, and the communist Sinn Fein is more of a nationalist party than a communist one, and being always in opposition to the 2 big centrist parties, Fianna Fail and Fine Gael, it does not pose a serious threat to economic development based on American capital and EU funds.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】爱尔兰目前担任欧盟理事会主席国，任期为期六个月。借此机会，我们有必要更深入地了解其经济状况。爱尔兰的经济前景较为乐观。假设中东冲突能够结束（这一冲突对爱尔兰出口导向型企业的冲击比乌克兰战争更为严重），我们预计将有新的外国直接投资涌入那些尚未得到充分开发的领域，例如人工智能计算中心、可再生能源（风力发电场）以及农业食品加工产业。传统上，爱尔兰会依赖美国的投资者，并获得欧盟基金的部分资金支持（尤其是在农业领域）。爱尔兰的经济精英们对特朗普加强美国影响力的政策寄予厚望。爱尔兰政府深知美国及其他外国企业的存在对就业和财政政策的重要性，因此将努力推动爱尔兰成为欧洲在21世纪现代技术领域的产业中心。美国经济的快速发展将增加对爱尔兰产品的需求，尤其是在高科技领域（包括太空技术——埃隆·马斯克计划在未来20年内推进的太空探索项目）；同时，能源价格的下降可能降低工业和交通运输领域的运营成本。到2030年，爱尔兰在欧盟内的政治地位将显著提升，与岛上较贫困的北部地区实现统一的可能性也将变得更加现实。一旦统一，并考虑到当前较高的移民率（人口替代率为1.15），统一的爱尔兰将拥有超过800万居民，重回18...。

papers.title: Beyond Reported Emissions: Uncovering Hidden Corporate Carbon Footprints
papers.abstract: Scope 3 emissions have become central to climate disclosure, but remain the least reliable component of firms' carbon footprints. This paper argues that the core measurement problem lies not only in the aggregate Scope 3 total, but in the heterogeneous quality of its underlying categories. Because some categories are far more difficult to observe, verify and compare than others, the aggregate figure embeds substantial noise—and, as we show, systematic omission. Using firm‐level disclosures from the CDP (Carbon Disclosure Project) database over 2013–2023, we implement a category‐level framework that first diagnoses, for each of the 15 GHG Protocol categories, whether a firm fully omits, partially under‐reports or soundly discloses it and then estimates the missing magnitude by machine learning. We find that hidden Scope 3 amounts to about 22% of reported emissions on a value‐weighted basis, while under‐reporting is near‐universal across firms—the median firm conceals 64% of its corrected footprint—but concentrated in tonnage among the largest emitters. Omission is not diffuse: it concentrates on use of sold products, the single category that most directly captures a firm's exposure to transition risk and that alone accounts for roughly two‐thirds of hidden emissions. Correcting these disclosures therefore reshapes firms' relative positions in the carbon distribution—44% of declarants change carbon‐intensity quintile—and selectively reveals the most financially material dimension of their carbon exposure. Reported Scope 3 carries a reliability ratio of at most 0.65 with respect to corrected exposure (0.62 within sectors), so carbon‐premium estimates built on it are attenuated by a third or more—distortions that affect ESG scoring, portfolio construction, transition‐risk assessment and the design of disclosure standards.
papers.summary_zh: 【绿色金融与可持续发展】范围3排放已成为气候信息披露的核心内容，但仍然是企业碳足迹中最不可靠的部分。本文认为，问题的核心不仅在于范围3排放总量的统计方法，还在于其各分类数据的质量参差不齐。由于某些类别的数据更难以观测、验证和比较，因此汇总数据中存在大量误差，且存在系统性遗漏。我们利用2013至2023年间碳披露项目（CDP）数据库中的企业级数据，建立了一个分类级分析框架：首先针对《温室气体议定书》规定的15个排放类别，判断企业是完全遗漏相关数据、部分低估排放量，还是如实披露了相关信息；随后通过机器学习方法估算出这些遗漏的排放量。研究发现，按价值加权计算，隐藏的范围3排放量约占报告总排放量的22%；而企业普遍存在低估排放量的现象——中等规模企业隐藏了其实际碳足迹的64%——且这种低估主要集中在排放量最大的企业中。数据遗漏并非随机分布，而是集中在“销售产品”的类别上，这一类别最能直接反映企业面临的转型风险，且隐藏的排放量占全部隐藏排放量的约三分之二。纠正这些披露信息后，企业在全球碳排放排名中的相对位置会发生显著变化（44%的企业碳强度排名发生变化）；同时，也能更准确地揭示其碳暴露风险的财务影响。经校正后的范...。研究方法：机器学习。

papers.title: The Structural Number of Parties: An Electoral-Outcome-Independent Baseline for Comparing Party-System Scale
papers.abstract: How many parties can a country structurally sustain? Standard measures such as the effective number of parties (ENP) cannot answer this question. They are descriptive and post hoc: they summarize competition only after an election, and they depend on electoral returns that are often missing, interrupted, or unreliable in many developing democracies, particularly in Africa. They also offer no common scale for comparing the size of party registers with realized electoral fragmentation. We introduce the Structural Number of Parties (SNP), an outcome-independent baseline derived from two universally available quantities: population size and territorial area. Building on the logic of the seat product model and the cube-root law of assembly size, the SNP gives an ex ante benchmark that can be computed for any country and year, including where electoral data are absent. Applied to African states, the SNP enables a structural gap diagnosis that distinguishes under-fragmented systems, marked by hegemonic-party dominance, from over-fragmented ones, marked by excessive atomization. The framework thus provides a transparent and reproducible tool to inform institutional reform and the rationalization of party systems across the continent.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】一个国家在结构上能够维持多少个政党？传统的衡量标准（如有效政党数量，Effective Number of Parties，ENP）无法回答这个问题。这些指标具有描述性，且属于事后分析：它们仅在选举结束后才对政党竞争情况进行总结，而且依赖于选举结果数据，而这些数据在许多发展中国家（尤其是非洲国家）往往缺失、不完整或不可靠。此外，这些指标也没有提供一个统一的尺度来比较政党登记册的规模与实际选举中的政党碎片化程度。我们提出了“结构政党数量”（Structural Number of Parties，SNP）这一概念，它是一个与选举结果无关的基准指标，基于两个普遍可获得的变量：人口规模和领土面积来计算。该指标借鉴了“席位乘积模型”（seat product model）和“议会规模立方根定律”（cube-root law of assembly size）的逻辑，能够为任何国家和地区（包括那些缺乏选举数据的地方）提供一个事前的评估基准。将SNP应用于非洲国家后，可以据此诊断出政党体系的结构性特征：那些以单一政党主导为特征的“低碎片化”体系，与那些政党过度分散、陷入过度碎片化的体系形成鲜...。

papers.title: ChainIT Transaction Truth: Stablecoins, Web3 Wallets, and Multi-Rail Commerce. A Zero-Trust Control Plane for Verified Identity, Organizational Authority, Runtime Compliance, Secure Wallet Execution, and Immutable Settlement Evidence
papers.abstract: Stablecoins can move value continuously across programmable networks, and Web3 wallets can authorize those transfers with cryptographic signatures, but neither capability, standing alone, establishes a complete commercial transaction. A blockchain may prove that a transaction satisfied protocol rules, and a wallet may prove that sufficient signing authority existed; neither proves who initiated the transaction, for which legal entity, under what current authority, against which current compliance evidence, on what exact instruction, or with what settlement and accounting outcome. We describe the ChainIT Transaction Truth Architecture, a zero-trust control, execution, and evidence architecture that places verified individual and organizational identity, the organizational authority record and authority policy of the ChainIT Authority Protocol, transaction-specific runtime compliance decisions, exact-digest approval, atomic capacity reservation, and a single-use Execution Authorization Credential in front of wallet execution, and that records settlement, reconciliation, and lifecycle evidence after the transaction. The architecture separates five boundaries: control of a key is not identity, identity is not organizational authority, authority is not compliance, compliance is not execution authority, and network confirmation is not complete commercial settlement. We describe wallet and custody profiles, including a multi-party computation (MPC) profile in which custody security is kept independent of business authority, stablecoin and Web3 evidence domains, layered finality, the U.S. stablecoin regulatory context as of September 2026, and a phased deployment in which pilot success requires that the control invariants hold under attack and failure.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】稳定币能够在可编程网络中持续传输价值，而Web3钱包则可以通过加密签名来授权这些转账操作。然而，这两种技术单独来看都无法完成一个完整的商业交易。区块链可以证明某笔交易符合协议规则，钱包也可以证明交易方具备必要的签名权限；但它们都无法确定交易的发起者、所属的法律实体、执行的依据、当前的合规性情况、具体的交易指令，以及最终的结算和会计结果。我们提出了ChainIT交易真实性架构（ChainIT Transaction Truth Architecture），这是一种基于零信任原则的控制、执行和证据管理系统。该架构在钱包执行前验证个人和组织身份、ChainIT权限协议的权限记录与政策、交易特定的运行时合规性要求、精确的摘要验证机制以及一次性使用的执行授权凭证，并在交易完成后记录结算结果、对账信息及交易的全生命周期证据。该架构明确了五个关键界限：密钥的控制权并不等同于身份；身份并不代表组织权限；权限并不等同于合规性；合规性并不等同于执行权限；网络确认也不等同于完整的商业结算。我们还描述了钱包和托管服务的具体配置，包括一种多方计算（MPC）机制，该机制确保托管安全性与业务权限相互独立；同时...。

papers.title: On the equilibrium lattice of supermodular games
papers.abstract: This paper shows how the meet and join of any pair of equilibria in a super- modular game can be constructed. The method relies on two one-directional best-response processes that I call contagion up and contagion down. Starting from any action profile, applying this pair of processes in opposite orders produces two equilibria that define its equilibrium envelope. The endpoints of the envelope are precisely the least and greatest equilibria reachable through arbitrary asynchronous best-response dynamics, and can only move closer together as players revise their actions. These and other results show how appending one-directional adjustment processes to the familiar equilibrium lattice structure allows us to explore the relationships between equilibria further.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】本文阐述了如何在超模块化博弈中构建任意一对均衡点的“相遇”与“结合”过程。该方法依赖于两种单向的最佳响应机制，我将其分别称为“上升型传染”（contagion up）和“下降型传染”（contagion down）。从任意一个行动组合出发，按相反的顺序依次应用这两种机制，可以生成两个均衡点，这两个均衡点共同构成了该行动组合的均衡包络（equilibrium envelope）。该均衡包络的端点分别代表通过任意异步最佳响应动态所能达到的最小均衡点和最大均衡点；随着玩家不断调整自己的行动，这两个端点只会越来越接近。这些发现以及其他相关结果表明，在传统的均衡格结构中加入单向调整机制，能够帮助我们更深入地探究不同均衡点之间的相互关系。。研究方法：均衡模型。

papers.title: Platform Recommendation and Competition in Search Markets
papers.abstract: Recommendation rules affect both sellers' incentives and the alternatives consumers expect to find. We develop a framework for evaluating these rules with heterogeneous sellers, endogenous pricing and advertising, and costly consumer search. For a broad class of separable recommendation scores, we establish conditions under which a unique market equilibrium exists. Three applications illustrate the use of the framework. A stronger reward for low prices does not necessarily lower equilibrium prices and benefit consumers when products are sufficiently differentiated in qualities. Quality guidance can lower the price of each product and benefit consumers while raising the average transaction price. With heterogeneous match distributions, a reward for the best initial inspection can help consumers with advertising fixed and harm them when advertising adjusts. A two-type design extension shows that no finite optimum over implementable outcomes uses positive weights on both quality and low prices, even when the platform values consumer surplus.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】推荐规则既影响卖方的激励机制，也影响消费者期望找到的替代产品。我们构建了一个框架，用于评估在卖方异质性、价格与广告行为内生化以及消费者搜索成本存在的情况下的这些规则。对于一类可分离的推荐评分，我们确定了市场存在唯一均衡的条件。通过三个具体案例展示了该框架的应用：当产品品质差异足够显著时，对低价商品给予更高奖励并不一定会降低均衡价格，反而可能使消费者受益；质量信息提示能够降低单个产品的价格并提升消费者的整体购买体验；在匹配机制存在差异的情况下，对初次评估表现最佳的卖家给予奖励有助于消费者（尤其是在广告固定不变的情况下），但当广告策略可调整时这种奖励反而可能对消费者产生不利影响。进一步的研究表明，即使平台重视消费者剩余，也不存在一个同时为产品质量和低价都赋予正权重的最优策略组合。。研究方法：均衡模型。

papers.title: Design-Based Inference for Fuzzy Difference-in-Differences
papers.abstract: I study fuzzy difference-in-differences designs from a design-based perspective, in which potential outcomes and treatment decisions are fixed and only the assignment of a policy is random, with heterogeneous and possibly unknown assignment probabilities. The Wald-DiD design estimand equals an assignment-weighted complier effect plus contamination from switchers, from changes in always-takers' effects and from trends in untreated outcomes. I derive the conditions under which the estimand holds a clear causal interpretation. The conditions are weaker than parallel trends in both outcomes and treatments. We propose an Anderson--Rubin-type test with a conservative Neyman variance that remains valid under weak first stages, a sensitivity analysis for the complier effect, and estimators for designs with known assignment probabilities. An application to the Oregon Health Insurance Experiment illustrates the results.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】我从基于设计的角度研究了模糊差异-in-differences（Fuzzy Difference-in-Differences, FDiD）方法。在这种方法中，潜在结果和治疗决策是固定的，只有政策的分配是随机的，且分配概率可能存在异质性且未知。Wald-DiD方法的估计量由分配权重加权的依从者效应（complier effect）以及来自转换者（switchers）、始终接受治疗者（always-takers）效应的变化以及未治疗结果趋势的干扰因素构成。我推导出了该估计量具有明确因果解释的条件。这些条件比要求结果和治疗之间存在平行趋势（parallel trends）的条件更为宽松。我们提出了一种Anderson-Rubin类型的检验方法，该方法具有保守的Neyman方差估计量，并且在处理第一阶段数据质量较差的情况时仍能保持有效性；同时，我们还对依从者效应进行了敏感性分析，并为已知分配概率的设计提供了相应的估计量。通过对俄勒冈州健康保险实验（Oregon Health Insurance Experiment）的应用，验证了这些研究结果的有效性。。研究方法：双重差分、实验方法。

papers.title: Development of Micro Enterprises Based on Local Potential in Improving the Economic Welfare of Vulnerable Communities: A Local Economic Development Approach
papers.venue: Dinasti International Journal of Economics, Finance & Accounting
papers.abstract: This study analyzes the utilization of local potential in micro business development by vulnerable communities in Ajaobaki Village, South Central Timor Regency (TTS), the application of the Local Economic Development (LED) approach, and the contribution of micro businesses to economic welfare. The research uses a descriptive qualitative method with in-depth interviews, observations, and documentation. The data was analyzed using the Miles and Huberman model with the help of NVivo. The results showed that the community developed five types of businesses, namely vegetables, coffee, livestock, weaving, and chips, but the utilization of potential was still extractive and hampered by limited capital, equipment, markets, and raw materials. The implementation of LED runs through business assistance of around IDR 30 million from the village government, annual training, business groups, and partnerships with foundations, cooperatives, PNM, Bank BRI, and Bank NTT. Before doing business, the community's income ranges from IDR 0 to IDR 500 thousand per month; after doing business, the average income is IDR 500 thousand to IDR 1 million per month, and some reach IDR 2 million. Micro businesses help vulnerable households meet their daily needs, but their income is not stable because they are affected by fuel prices and market changes. Strengthening supply and market partnerships is needed so that the contribution of micro businesses is more stable.
papers.summary_zh: 【收入分配与福利】本研究分析了南中帝汶县（TTS）Ajaobaki村弱势群体在微型企业发展中如何利用当地资源，探讨了地方经济发展（Local Economic Development, LED）方法的应用，以及微型企业对经济福利的贡献。研究采用描述性定性方法，通过深入访谈、观察和文献资料收集数据，并运用Miles和Huberman模型结合NVivo软件对数据进行分析。研究结果表明，该村发展了五种类型的微型企业：蔬菜种植、咖啡生产、畜牧业、编织业和薯片加工。然而，资源利用仍以资源开采为主，受到资金、设备、市场及原材料限制的制约。地方经济发展计划的实施主要依赖于村政府提供的约3000万印尼盾的援助资金、年度培训活动，以及与各类基金会、合作社、PNM机构、BRI银行和NTT银行的合作。创业前，社区居民的月收入在0至50万印尼盾之间；创业后，平均月收入提升至50万至100万印尼盾，部分家庭的收入甚至达到200万印尼盾。微型企业帮助弱势家庭满足了基本生活需求，但由于受燃料价格和市场波动影响，其收入并不稳定。因此，需要加强供应链和市场合作，以提升微型企业的可持续发展能力。。

papers.title: Firm Behavior, Structure, and Constraints in Egyptian Manufacturing: Introducing the Egyptian Industrial Firm Behavior Survey Through an Adapted Structure–Conduct–Performance Framework
papers.venue: Review of Middle East Economics and Finance
papers.abstract: Abstract This paper introduces the Egyptian Industrial Firm Behavior Survey (EIFBS) 2020/21 and develops the conceptual framework guiding the accompanying special issue. Drawing on data covering 2,383 manufacturing firms, it adapts the Structure–Conduct–Performance framework to place firm behavior and institutions at the center of analysis and to allow for feedbacks between firm conduct and performance. It then provides a descriptive sectoral diagnostic of market concentration, employment generation, technological upgrading, firm-size transitions, and institutional constraints. The observed patterns suggest differences between concentrated, capital- and policy-intensive sectors, which exhibit greater technological upgrading but limited employment generation, and more competitive, labor-intensive sectors, which absorb more firms and workers but display lower upgrading and firm-size mobility. These patterns are descriptive and do not establish causal relationships. Together, the eight accompanying papers use the EIFBS to examine productivity, firm growth, digitalization and innovation, institutional constraints, exporting, spatial agglomeration, labor demand, and firms’ adjustment to COVID-19.
papers.summary_zh: 【公司金融】摘要：本文介绍了2020/21年度的埃及工业企业行为调查（Egyptian Industrial Firm Behavior Survey, EIFBS），并构建了指导该专题研究的概念框架。基于涵盖2,383家制造业企业的数据，本文将“结构-行为-绩效”（Structure-Conduct-Performance, SCP）框架进行调整，将企业行为与制度因素置于分析的核心位置，同时探讨企业行为与绩效之间的相互作用。随后，本文对市场集中度、就业创造、技术升级、企业规模变化以及制度约束等领域进行了详细的行业分析。研究结果表明，资本密集型和政策依赖型行业在技术升级方面表现较好，但就业创造能力有限；而劳动密集型行业则更具竞争力，能够吸纳更多企业和劳动力，但在技术升级和企业规模变动方面表现较弱。这些观察结果仅揭示了行业间的差异，并未建立因果关系。八篇配套论文共同利用EIFBS数据，探讨了生产效率、企业增长、数字化与创新、制度约束、出口活动、空间集聚、劳动力需求以及企业对新冠疫情的应对策略。。研究方法：调查数据。
